text: Owner, 2026-11-27 03:15 in chat: "shouldn't that be the handover's fault then? Why was there a handover instead of it just asking you to run the resume command?" Added to CL62: the hand-over (kit.py guide hand-over / the hand-over comment) holds only what the board does not (the owner's chat decisions, a half-done action); any step-state claim (waits on, next, blocked by) is refused when written, since resume computes it from the board. Resume shows the hand-over after the queue, never as a plan.
